vault_lock_policy: Scheduled jobs lock SHINOBU-owned buffers including telemetry/cursor rows, ConstructionSocketModules/ConstructionSocketCounters when consumed, and optional VoxelSdfTexture3D until finalize/upload or teardown; views are re-read after locks through pure TryReadHandle paths. socket_snapshot_policy: Foundation holds ShinobuSocketConstructionRuntime.TryBeginModuleReadFence across scheduled socket-module reads; socket mock writes use TryBeginModuleWriteFence. profile_reload_policy: CSV profile reloads use a SHINOBU profile write fence plus Vault locks for ray origins/profile ranges/CSV scratch; scheduled pylon jobs hold a profile read fence until JobHandle finalization. The public byte parser owns the write fence, exact-matches header first tokens, rejects empty module hash cells, and file import releases only the profile locks actually acquired by that caller.
origin_policy: Runtime schedule uses cached origin AUP from cold setup/IOriginShiftListener and cached player camera from cold GlobalRegistry.Player snapshot plus IGlobalRegistryHotSwapListener; shader receives scheduled camera world offset for world reconstruction.
gpu_policy: One procedural indirect draw; no pylon GameObjects; inactive support slots are compacted out before upload and indirect InstanceCount. The shader is opaque ZWrite, always-included by GUID 0e3d6c95b94344c7b864f17da3f25205, and its variant collection GUID 0e3d6c95b94344c7b864f17da3f25207 is preloaded and serialized in 00_BOOTSTRAP.unity shaderVariantCollections for GameBootstrapper warmup. Matrix X/Z stores diameter for the local-radius-0.5 procedural cylinder. Runtime proof remains pending.
quality_route: GlobalQualityWeight continuously drives shaped ray budget, radius, flare, march steps, SDF interpolation, and active draw pressure. Below 0.3: one nearest-neighbor SDF proxy read per ray and up-normal, with march and 6-sample gradient bypassed. Transitional rays fade by radius/flare scale instead of popping at full thickness; the default first ray slides from center to the fourth corner only near Ultra so the 4-ray budget covers all four corners.
rollback_fence: PylonMatrixDTO and FoundationPylonSurfaceDTO are presentation-only and excluded from StateRingBuffer/Merkle ownership.
